name: posttooluse-sdd-coding
description: Remind SDD coding style after writing .mjs files
reason:
**[SDD Coding Check]** You just wrote .mjs code. Verify:
1. fn defined OUTSIDE setup — setup only wires bus.handle
2. Internal fn has `_` prefix, not exported
3. **Schema-first**: no schema = no code. Write schema before implementation
4. ObjectTree is an object — build → use → exit. NOT a dict factory
5. No log boilerplate (bus trace handles start/done/error)
6. setup returns pure teardown function, not object
7. config.prop direct access, no destructure

Run `/sdd:coding` to check style. Run `/sdd:schema` if schema missing.
Runtime: schema2object.mjs ObjectTree — understand `$` prefix API before using.
